scale_method: 82.2m published inner-floor endpoint used solely as dimensional prior. Outer facade cannot be equated with this diameter. No calibrated camera or orthographic plan; width/depth ratios are adjustable photo-informed modelling candidates.
uncertainty: Metric error unbounded: oblique aerial, unknown lens/camera pose, roof height and hidden boundary. No perspective rectification performed. Local azimuth not geographic north. Roof curves, numeric dimensions, levels, facade joints and pavilions remain replacement-ready candidates.
